icons.name: Theme
icons.description: A window paired with a palette, representing interface theme selection.

icons.name: Background
icons.description: Overlapping tiles with the rear tile highlighted, representing background adjustment.

icons.name: Foreground
icons.description: Overlapping tiles with the front tile highlighted, representing foreground adjustment.

icons.name: Run program
icons.description: An application window paired with a play triangle, representing program execution.

icons.name: Exposure
icons.description: A sun symbol paired with a plus/minus scale, representing overall image exposure adjustment.

icons.name: Shadows
icons.description: A tonal gradient with its dark region highlighted, representing adjustment of detail in shadow areas.

icons.name: Highlights
icons.description: A tonal gradient with its bright region highlighted, representing adjustment of the brightest image areas.

icons.name: Tone curves
icons.description: A square coordinate grid containing an S-shaped curve and editable control points.

icons.name: Levels
icons.description: A histogram with black-point, midtone, and white-point sliders beneath it.

icons.name: Vibrance
icons.description: Muted and vivid color swatches paired with an adjustment slider, representing selective enhancement of less saturated colors.

icons.name: Color temperature
icons.description: A thermometer beside a blue-to-orange gradient, representing cool-to-warm color adjustment.

icons.name: Tint
icons.description: A green-to-magenta gradient with a central slider, representing tint adjustment along that color axis.

icons.name: Sharpness
icons.description: A split image edge shown soft on one side and crisp on the other, representing sharpening adjustment.

icons.name: Noise reduction
icons.description: A dotted image patch transitioning into a smooth patch, representing reduction of image noise.

icons.name: Vignette
icons.description: A rectangular image frame with darkened corners and a bright center, representing edge-darkening adjustment.

icons.name: Resolution
icons.description: An image frame with horizontal and vertical pixel dimensions marked along its edges.

icons.name: Aspect ratio
icons.description: Overlapping portrait, square, and landscape frames represent different image proportions.

icons.name: Image bit depth
icons.description: Two tonal ramps with coarse and fine gradations represent different levels of color precision.

icons.name: Color space
icons.description: Nested color-gamut outlines represent selection of color spaces such as sRGB and Display P3.

icons.name: Color profile
icons.description: A color-swatch document paired with an image represents an embedded ICC color profile.

icons.name: Compression quality
icons.description: An image thumbnail paired with a quality slider and file-size indicator represents the balance between detail and compression.

icons.name: Image transparency
icons.description: A partially transparent image tile reveals a checkerboard background beneath it.

icons.name: ISO sensitivity
icons.description: A camera sensor paired with a sensitivity scale and grain dots represents ISO adjustment.

icons.name: Exposure compensation
icons.description: A camera paired with a centered negative-to-positive EV scale represents compensation relative to metered exposure.

icons.name: Metering mode
icons.description: Three viewfinder frames show full-frame, center-weighted, and spot metering patterns.

icons.name: Lens focal length
icons.description: A lens beside wide and narrow viewing-angle cones represents focal length selection.

icons.name: Autofocus mode
icons.description: A focus bracket paired with a still subject and a moving subject represents single and continuous autofocus.

icons.name: Focus area
icons.description: A viewfinder grid with one highlighted point and a larger highlighted zone represents focus-area selection.

icons.name: Image stabilization
icons.description: A camera surrounded by vibration marks and a steady central frame represents shake compensation.

icons.name: High dynamic range
icons.description: Three differently exposed photo frames combine into one image retaining bright and dark details.

icons.name: Exposure bracketing
icons.description: Three stacked camera frames marked with negative, neutral, and positive exposure indicators represent a bracketed capture sequence.

icons.name: RAW capture
icons.description: A camera sensor paired with an unprocessed image file represents recording raw sensor data.

icons.name: Hue
icons.description: A circular color wheel with a movable marker represents hue adjustment.

icons.name: HSL adjustment
icons.description: A selected color swatch sits beside three sliders for hue, saturation, and lightness.

icons.name: Channel mixer
icons.description: Red, green, and blue channel streams converge into a single output swatch.

icons.name: Color grading
icons.description: Three small color wheels represent separate color treatments for shadows, midtones, and highlights.

icons.name: Selective color adjustment
icons.description: One color group is isolated from a row of swatches and paired with adjustment sliders.

icons.name: Black-and-white conversion
icons.description: A split photo transitions from colored details to grayscale tones.

icons.name: LUT color mapping
icons.description: A color cube connects an original image thumbnail to a differently graded version.

icons.name: Selection tool
icons.description: A dashed boundary surrounds a selected region inside an image frame.

icons.name: Lasso selection
icons.description: An irregular dashed loop with a cursor represents a freehand selection boundary.

icons.name: Subject selection
icons.description: A subject silhouette is outlined inside a photo while the background remains unselected.

icons.name: Image mask
icons.description: An image thumbnail paired with a black-and-white mask represents selective visibility or editing.

icons.name: Mask feathering
icons.description: A selection edge transitions gradually from opaque to transparent, representing a softened mask boundary.

icons.name: Local adjustment
icons.description: A brush highlights a small region within a photo beside an adjustment slider.

icons.name: Graduated filter
icons.description: A landscape frame contains a linear overlay fading from a strong effect to no effect.

icons.name: Radial filter
icons.description: An elliptical overlay with a soft edge highlights a region for local tonal adjustment.

icons.name: Healing brush
icons.description: A brush crosses a small blemish that blends into the surrounding image texture.

icons.name: Clone stamp
icons.description: A stamp links a source patch to a matching destination patch within an image.

icons.name: Content-aware fill
icons.description: A missing image region is filled with texture matching its surrounding area.

icons.name: Red-eye removal
icons.description: A pair of eyes shows a red pupil changing to a natural dark pupil.

icons.name: Skin retouching
icons.description: A facial detail patch shows reduced blemishes while retaining visible skin texture.

icons.name: Dodge and burn
icons.description: Two brush tips respectively lighten and darken small areas of the same image.

icons.name: Background removal
icons.description: An isolated subject remains in front of a checkerboard transparency background.

icons.name: Perspective correction
icons.description: A tilted trapezoidal building outline transforms into a rectangle with parallel vertical edges.

icons.name: Lens distortion correction
icons.description: A bowed grid transitions into a straight grid, representing correction of barrel or pincushion distortion.

icons.name: Chromatic aberration removal
icons.description: A magnified edge loses its red and blue fringes after correction.

icons.name: Dehaze
icons.description: A misty landscape thumbnail transitions into a clearer version with recovered contrast.

icons.name: Texture adjustment
icons.description: A magnified textured surface paired with a slider represents control of fine and medium-sized detail.

icons.name: Clarity adjustment
icons.description: A midtone detail patch gains stronger local contrast without changing the image dimensions.

icons.name: Film grain
icons.description: A photo patch with evenly distributed grain dots sits beside an intensity slider.

icons.name: Image layers
icons.description: Several separated image planes stack vertically to represent independently editable layers.

icons.name: Layer blend mode
icons.description: Overlapping colored tiles produce different intersection effects, representing layer blending operations.

icons.name: Photo metadata
icons.description: A photo thumbnail paired with an information panel containing camera, time, and location symbols represents EXIF metadata.

icons.name: Objectives and key results (OKR)
icons.description: A target connected to several measurable result markers, representing an objective and its key results.

icons.name: OKR objective
icons.description: A flag at the top of a stepped path, representing the direction and ambition of an objective.

icons.name: OKR key result
icons.description: A checklist paired with a progress gauge, representing a measurable outcome linked to an objective.

icons.name: OKR alignment
icons.description: Connected targets arranged in a hierarchy, representing alignment between organizational, team, and individual objectives.

icons.name: OKR check-in
icons.description: A target paired with a circular update arrow and a small progress marker.

icons.name: OKR review
icons.description: A target beside a report and magnifying glass, representing review of outcomes and lessons learned.

icons.name: Key performance indicator (KPI)
icons.description: A gauge with a highlighted benchmark and a small chart, representing measurement against a performance target.

icons.name: KPI target value
icons.description: A bar chart with a clearly marked target line.

icons.name: KPI achievement rate
icons.description: A partially filled progress ring paired with a target symbol.

icons.name: KPI scorecard
icons.description: A compact table containing several metric rows and rating indicators.

icons.name: KPI alert
icons.description: A performance gauge paired with a warning triangle, representing a metric outside its expected range.

icons.name: Employee attendance
icons.description: An employee badge paired with a clock and check mark.

icons.name: Clock in
icons.description: A clock with an inward arrow and a check mark, representing the start of a work period.

icons.name: Clock out
icons.description: A clock with an outward arrow, representing the end of a work period.

icons.name: Attendance record
icons.description: A calendar-style sheet with daily check marks and time indicators.

icons.name: Attendance exception
icons.description: A clock paired with a warning symbol, representing an attendance record requiring attention.

icons.name: Late arrival
icons.description: An employee badge beside a clock whose hand has passed a marked start time.

icons.name: Early departure
icons.description: An outward arrow beside a clock whose hand has not yet reached a marked end time.

icons.name: Employee absence
icons.description: A calendar cell containing a missing-person silhouette and a minus sign.

icons.name: Missed punch
icons.description: A time-record card with an empty entry highlighted by a question mark.

icons.name: Attendance correction request
icons.description: A time-record card paired with a pencil and a small plus sign.

icons.name: Leave request
icons.description: A calendar with selected days and a small request document.

icons.name: Overtime work
icons.description: A briefcase paired with a clock and a plus sign, representing additional working time.

icons.name: Shift schedule
icons.description: A calendar grid with alternating time blocks and employee markers.

icons.name: Work hours summary
icons.description: A clock paired with a bar chart, representing aggregated working hours.

icons.name: Attendance report
icons.description: A report sheet combining a calendar, check marks, and a compact summary chart.

icons.name: Graph theory
icons.description: The study of mathematical graphs composed of vertices and edges, which can be represented by a few dots and connecting lines, distinct from statistical charts.

icons.name: Gravity
icons.description: An apple falling toward Earth, with a downward arrow indicating gravitational force.

icons.name: Friction
icons.description: A block sliding across a rough surface, with a force arrow opposing its motion.

icons.name: Buoyancy
icons.description: A partially submerged object with an upward force arrow beneath it.

icons.name: Elastic force
icons.description: A stretched spring with an arrow pointing toward its original resting position.

icons.name: Tension
icons.description: A taut rope supporting a hanging weight, with an upward force arrow along the rope.

icons.name: Pressure
icons.description: Several downward force arrows pressing onto a clearly outlined contact surface.

icons.name: Inertia
icons.description: A wheeled cart stopped by a barrier while a loose ball continues moving forward.

icons.name: Action and reaction
icons.description: Two contacting objects with equal-length force arrows pointing in opposite directions.

icons.name: Lever principle
icons.description: A rigid bar resting on a triangular fulcrum, with weights placed on opposite sides.

icons.name: Torque
icons.description: A wrench turning a bolt, with a curved arrow around the bolt axis.

icons.name: Circular motion
icons.description: A ball following a circular path, with a tangential arrow indicating its motion.

icons.name: Centripetal force
icons.description: An object on a circular path with a force arrow pointing directly toward the center.

icons.name: Projectile motion
icons.description: A launched ball following a dotted parabolic trajectory.

icons.name: Collision
icons.description: Two balls meeting with opposing motion arrows and a small impact mark.

icons.name: Oscillation
icons.description: A mass attached to a spring, with ghosted positions on either side of its equilibrium point.

icons.name: Resonance
icons.description: Two matching tuning forks, with vibration marks showing one exciting the other.

icons.name: Sound waves
icons.description: A vibrating tuning fork emitting alternating compressed and sparse bands of air particles.

icons.name: Transverse wave
icons.description: A sinusoidal rope with an up-down vibration arrow perpendicular to a horizontal propagation arrow.

icons.name: Longitudinal wave
icons.description: A spring with alternating compressed and expanded sections, with vibration and propagation arrows along the same axis.

icons.name: Light waves
icons.description: A luminous sinusoidal wave with an arrow indicating its direction of propagation.

icons.name: Light reflection
icons.description: A light ray striking a flat mirror and reflecting away at an equal angle.

icons.name: Light refraction
icons.description: A light ray changing direction as it crosses the boundary between air and water.

icons.name: Light dispersion
icons.description: A triangular prism splitting a white light beam into a fan of rainbow colors.

icons.name: Wave diffraction
icons.description: Parallel wavefronts passing through a narrow opening and spreading into semicircular wavefronts.

icons.name: Wave interference
icons.description: Two overlapping sets of circular water ripples forming alternating reinforced and canceled bands.

icons.name: Convex lens focusing
icons.description: Parallel light rays passing through a convex lens and meeting at a focal point.

icons.name: Heat conduction
icons.description: A solid rod transitioning from a hot red end to a cool blue end, with heat-flow arrows along it.

icons.name: Thermal convection
icons.description: A fluid container with rising red arrows and descending blue arrows forming a circulation loop.

icons.name: Thermal radiation
icons.description: A hot object emitting outward wavy arrows across empty space.

icons.name: Thermal expansion
icons.description: A heated metal bar shown beside a shorter cool version, with outward expansion arrows.

icons.name: Electric current
icons.description: A closed circuit containing a battery and lit bulb, with arrows along the wire indicating conventional current.

icons.name: Electric field
icons.description: A positive charge surrounded by radial field lines with outward-pointing arrows.

icons.name: Magnetic field
icons.description: A bar magnet surrounded by curved magnetic field lines connecting its two poles.

icons.name: Electromagnet
icons.description: A wire coil wrapped around an iron core and connected to a battery, attracting small iron pieces.

icons.name: Electromagnetic induction
icons.description: A magnet moving into a wire coil connected to a meter with a deflected needle.

icons.name: Atomic nucleus
icons.description: A compact cluster of differently colored protons and neutrons, visually distinct from electron shells.

icons.name: Nuclear fission
icons.description: A large atomic nucleus splitting into two smaller nuclei while releasing several neutrons.

icons.name: Nuclear fusion
icons.description: Two small atomic nuclei joining into a larger nucleus, accompanied by a compact energy burst.

icons.name: Coupe SUV
icons.description: An SUV with a coupe-inspired roofline that slopes toward the rear while retaining a raised ride height.

icons.name: Shooting brake
icons.description: A sporty wagon with a long roof, a sloping rear profile, and a rear hatch, combining coupe styling with cargo space.

icons.name: Liftback
icons.description: A sedan-like car whose rear window and trunk lid lift together as one large hatch.

icons.name: Fastback sedan
icons.description: A sedan with a roofline that flows smoothly down to the tail and a trunk lid that opens separately from the rear window.

icons.name: Policy endorsement
icons.description: Modification of an existing insurance policy through an endorsement, not an approval or signing action.

icons.name: Reinsurance
icons.description: An insurance company transfers part of its underwriting risk to other insurance institutions, which can be represented by a two-layer protection structure.

icons.name: Insurance subrogation
icons.description: After the insurer compensates the insured, it legally seeks recovery from the responsible party, which can be represented by a two-step process of compensation and recovery.

icons.name: Building information model
icons.description: A digital model of a building that associates component properties, which can be represented by a combination of building blocks and data markers.

icons.name: Network jitter
icons.description: Variation in packet transmission delay, which can be represented by unevenly spaced arrival markers, distinct from latency itself.

icons.name: Quality of service
icons.description: Prioritization and resource allocation to ensure service quality for specific network traffic, which can be represented by tiered channels.

icons.name: Network port
icons.description: A logical port used at the transport layer to distinguish between services, not a physical USB or Ethernet port.

icons.name: Garbage collection
icons.description: Automatic reclamation of memory no longer used by a program, not a file recycle bin or household waste recycling.

icons.name: Mutex
icons.description: Coordination of concurrent tasks accessing shared resources, not a general interface lock state.

icons.name: Message queue
icons.description: A queue used for asynchronous message delivery between systems, not a list of chat messages.

icons.name: Aries
icons.description: A ram’s head with curled horns, optionally paired with the constellation’s main stars.

icons.name: Taurus
icons.description: A bull’s head with prominent horns, optionally incorporating a V-shaped star pattern.

icons.name: Gemini
icons.description: Two matching human silhouettes or paired star figures, emphasizing the celestial twins.

icons.name: Cancer
icons.description: A crab with two raised claws and a compact, symmetrical body.

icons.name: Leo
icons.description: A lion’s head with a bold mane, optionally paired with a sickle-shaped star pattern.

icons.name: Virgo
icons.description: A maiden’s profile holding a wheat stalk, with a bright star marking Spica.

icons.name: Libra
icons.description: A balanced pair of scales with two clearly separated pans.

icons.name: Scorpius
icons.description: A scorpion with prominent pincers and a curved, hooked tail.

icons.name: Sagittarius
icons.description: A drawn bow and arrow, providing a compact alternative to a full centaur archer.

icons.name: Capricornus
icons.description: A sea-goat combining a horned goat’s head with a curled fish tail.

icons.name: Aquarius
icons.description: A tilted water jar pouring two flowing streams.

icons.name: Pisces
icons.description: Two fish swimming in opposite directions, joined by a curved cord.

icons.name: Ursa Major
icons.description: A bear silhouette incorporating the Big Dipper’s seven-star pattern. The Big Dipper is an asterism within this larger constellation.

icons.name: Ursa Minor
icons.description: A small bear paired with the Little Dipper, highlighting Polaris at the end of the handle.

icons.name: Orion
icons.description: A simplified hunter-shaped star outline with three aligned belt stars as its defining feature.

icons.name: Cassiopeia
icons.description: Five bright stars connected into a distinctive W shape, optionally accented with a crown.

icons.name: Cepheus
icons.description: A house-shaped pentagon of stars paired with a small royal crown.

icons.name: Andromeda
icons.description: A maiden’s profile with a short broken-chain motif and a branching star pattern, distinct from an Andromeda Galaxy icon.

icons.name: Perseus
icons.description: A heroic figure represented by a helmet and raised sword, paired with a branching star outline.

icons.name: Pegasus
icons.description: A winged horse paired with the Great Square of Pegasus, a recognizable asterism associated with this constellation.

icons.name: Cygnus
icons.description: A swan with outstretched wings aligned with the constellation’s Northern Cross star pattern.

icons.name: Lyra
icons.description: A small lyre with a few visible strings and a prominent star representing Vega.

icons.name: Aquila
icons.description: An eagle with spread wings and three aligned stars, highlighting Altair in the middle.

icons.name: Draco
icons.description: A winding dragon silhouette with an elongated, serpentine chain of stars.

icons.name: Hercules
icons.description: A muscular hero holding a club, optionally incorporating the four-star Keystone asterism.

icons.name: Ophiuchus
icons.description: A human figure holding a snake across both hands. This constellation crosses the ecliptic but is not one of the traditional twelve zodiac signs.

icons.name: Serpens
icons.description: A flowing snake outline with separate head and tail star groups, reflecting the constellation’s two sky regions.

icons.name: Canis Major
icons.description: A large dog silhouette with an especially bright star representing Sirius.

icons.name: Canis Minor
icons.description: A small dog beside a simple two-star connection, highlighting Procyon.

icons.name: Crux
icons.description: Four main stars form a compact cross, with a smaller fifth star offset to one side.

icons.name: Corona Borealis
icons.description: A semicircular arc of stars resembling a delicate crown.

icons.name: Delphinus
icons.description: A leaping dolphin paired with a small diamond-shaped star group and a short trailing connection.

icons.name: Corvus
icons.description: A crow’s silhouette paired with the constellation’s compact four-star quadrilateral.

icons.name: Boötes
icons.description: A kite-shaped star outline with a prominent orange star representing Arcturus.

icons.name: Cetus
icons.description: A stylized whale or mythological sea monster with a curved tail and a few star accents.

icons.name: Phoenix
icons.description: A rising phoenix with sweeping wings and a flame-shaped tail, paired with a compact star outline.

icons.name: Foxtail grass
icons.description: A slender stem topped with a dense, fuzzy cylindrical seed head.

icons.name: Fountain grass
icons.description: Arching narrow leaves surround upright stems with fluffy, bottlebrush-shaped flower spikes.

icons.name: Pampas grass
icons.description: Tall stalks carry large, feathery cream-colored plumes above a fountain of long leaves.

icons.name: Cogon grass
icons.description: Slim upright leaves accompany narrow, silky white flower spikes.

icons.name: Blue fescue
icons.description: Fine blue-gray blades form a compact, spiky hemispherical tuft.

icons.name: Zebra grass
icons.description: Long arching green blades feature distinctive pale yellow horizontal bands.

icons.name: Quaking grass
icons.description: Delicate branching stems carry dangling, flattened heart-shaped spikelets.

icons.name: Bunny tail grass
icons.description: Thin stalks end in soft, oval white seed heads resembling tiny rabbit tails.

icons.name: Feather grass
icons.description: Fine blades and exceptionally long, hairlike seed awns create a flowing feathered silhouette.

icons.name: Common reed
icons.description: Tall jointed stalks bear long pointed leaves and loose, branching flower plumes.

icons.name: Wild oats
icons.description: Open branching seed heads carry drooping oat spikelets with long projecting awns.

icons.name: Bottlebrush grass
icons.description: Seed heads have stiff bristles radiating outward like a narrow bottle brush.

icons.name: Ginkgo tree
icons.description: Distinctive fan-shaped leaves with a central notch turn bright yellow in autumn.

icons.name: Maple tree
icons.description: A spreading crown carries pointed, palmately lobed leaves that can be shown in autumn red.

icons.name: Weeping willow
icons.description: Long, curtainlike branches hang downward from a rounded crown.

icons.name: White birch
icons.description: Slender white trunks are marked with contrasting dark horizontal patches.

icons.name: Baobab tree
icons.description: An enormous swollen trunk supports a relatively small crown of thick, twisting branches.

icons.name: Umbrella thorn acacia
icons.description: A broad, flat umbrella-shaped canopy spreads above a slender branching trunk.

icons.name: Banyan tree
icons.description: A wide canopy sends dangling aerial roots downward to form additional pillar-like trunks.

icons.name: Cedar tree
icons.description: Long horizontal branches form layered tiers, with a gently drooping top and branch tips.

icons.name: Italian cypress
icons.description: Dense foliage forms a very tall, narrow column tapering to a pointed tip.

icons.name: Spruce tree
icons.description: A sharply conical crown has dense tiered branches and elongated hanging cones.

icons.name: Monkey puzzle tree
icons.description: Widely spaced whorls of stiff branches are covered in overlapping triangular, scale-like leaves.

icons.name: Eucalyptus tree
icons.description: A pale, peeling trunk supports an airy crown of long, hanging sickle-shaped leaves.

icons.name: Oak tree
icons.description: A stout trunk and broad crown pair with rounded-lobed leaves and capped acorns.

icons.name: Giant sequoia
icons.description: A massive reddish, flared trunk rises into a towering crown with dense conifer foliage.

icons.name: Maidenhair fern
icons.description: Fine dark stems branch into delicate fans of small, rounded leaflets.

icons.name: Bird’s nest fern
icons.description: Broad, undivided strap-shaped fronds radiate from a central nestlike rosette.

icons.name: Staghorn fern
icons.description: Forked antler-shaped fronds emerge above rounded shield-like basal fronds.

icons.name: Rabbit’s foot fern
icons.description: Lacy triangular fronds grow above conspicuous furry rhizomes resembling rabbit feet.

icons.name: Tree fern
icons.description: A single upright trunk is topped by a spreading umbrella of large, finely divided fronds.

icons.name: Sword fern
icons.description: Long arching fronds have orderly rows of narrow leaflets along a central stem.

icons.name: Japanese holly fern
icons.description: Glossy fronds carry broad, pointed leaflets resembling holly leaves.

icons.name: Cinnamon fern
icons.description: Green divided fronds surround upright cinnamon-brown fertile fronds with a dense, narrow silhouette.

icons.name: Sensitive fern
icons.description: Broad, deeply lobed green fronds contrast with upright fertile stalks bearing beadlike segments.

icons.name: Royal fern
icons.description: Large fronds have widely spaced oval leaflets, with branching rusty-brown fertile clusters at their tips.

icons.name: Japanese painted fern
icons.description: Finely divided silver-gray fronds feature contrasting burgundy stems and purple accents.

icons.name: Resurrection fern
icons.description: Small leathery fronds grow along creeping rhizomes, with dry leaflets curling inward into tight rolls.

icons.name: Fly agaric
icons.description: A bright red cap dotted with white warts sits above a white stalk with a skirtlike ring.

icons.name: Morel
icons.description: An elongated cap has a strongly textured honeycomb surface of deep pits and ridges.

icons.name: Chanterelle
icons.description: A golden-yellow funnel-shaped cap has a wavy rim and folds running down the stalk.

icons.name: Oyster mushroom
icons.description: Overlapping fan-shaped caps form a layered cluster, with short off-center stalks.

icons.name: Shiitake
icons.description: A rounded brown cap can display a distinctive pale cracked pattern above a stout cream-colored stalk.

icons.name: Enoki
icons.description: A tight bundle of very long, thin white stems is topped with tiny rounded caps.

icons.name: Lion’s mane mushroom
icons.description: A rounded white mass is covered with long dangling spines, resembling a shaggy pom-pom.

icons.name: Wood ear mushroom
icons.description: Dark brown, ear-shaped lobes have thin, folded edges and a softly rippled surface.

icons.name: Turkey tail mushroom
icons.description: Thin overlapping fans display concentric bands of contrasting brown, cream, and gray.

icons.name: Reishi mushroom
icons.description: A glossy reddish-brown kidney-shaped cap grows from a curved, off-center stalk.

icons.name: Giant puffball
icons.description: A large, smooth white sphere rests close to the ground without a visible umbrella-shaped cap.

icons.name: Shaggy ink cap
icons.description: A tall cylindrical white cap is covered in shaggy scales, with a darkening lower rim.

icons.name: Hardshell jacket
icons.description: A hooded outdoor jacket with a high collar, waterproof front zipper, and zippered chest pockets.

icons.name: Trench coat
icons.description: A long double-breasted coat with wide lapels, a waist belt, and cuff straps.

icons.name: Biker jacket
icons.description: A short leather jacket with an asymmetric front zipper, broad lapels, and metal fasteners.

icons.name: Poncho
icons.description: A loose, sleeveless garment with a central neck opening and a broad triangular silhouette.

icons.name: Hanfu
icons.description: A traditional Chinese cross-collar robe with wide sleeves, a right-over-left closure, and a tied waist sash.

icons.name: Bomber jacket
icons.description: A short zip-front jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband, plus a small zippered sleeve pocket.

icons.name: Tape recorder
icons.description: A portable recorder with a visible cassette compartment, built-in microphone, and recording and playback buttons.

icons.name: Countdown timer
icons.description: A compact digital timer with a remaining-time display and start, pause, and reset buttons.

icons.name: Mechanical kitchen timer
icons.description: A wind-up timer with a rotating dial and clearly marked minute divisions.

icons.name: Chess clock
icons.description: Two adjacent clock faces with alternating top buttons, used to track each player's remaining time.

icons.name: World clock
icons.description: A compact panel with three clock faces showing different times and a small globe symbol to represent multiple time zones.

icons.name: Movie
icons.description: A cinema screen paired with a film reel, representing a feature film.

icons.name: Television series
icons.description: A television screen paired with stacked episode cards, representing serialized drama.

icons.name: Variety show
icons.description: A stage microphone framed by spotlights and stars, representing variety entertainment.

icons.name: Anime
icons.description: A stylized animated character portrait inside a screen, representing anime content.

icons.name: Documentary
icons.description: A video camera paired with a globe and magnifying glass, representing factual storytelling.

icons.name: Music video
icons.description: A video screen containing a play symbol and musical note.

icons.name: Entertainment news
icons.description: A news microphone paired with a star and camera flash, representing entertainment reporting.

icons.name: Current affairs news
icons.description: A globe paired with a news microphone and headline bars, representing current affairs reporting.

icons.name: Short film
icons.description: A compact film strip paired with a small clock, representing a short cinematic work.

icons.name: Short video
icons.description: A vertical smartphone screen containing a play symbol and a compact progress bar.

icons.name: Interview program
icons.description: Two facing chairs with a microphone between them, representing a recorded interview.

icons.name: Sports broadcast
icons.description: A television screen containing a ball and a small broadcast signal symbol.
